settings.heading: A corner of your own.
settings.description: A comfortable chair. A little daylight. Some time that is just yours.

settings.heading: Your own corner
settings.label: Reading corner
settings.description: A chair for your book, your coffee, your afternoon.

settings.heading: Your smallest escape.
settings.description: You do not need a whole room to make a place of your own. Begin with a chair you look forward to sitting in.
settings.body_one: Choose a position near daylight and add a reading lamp for evenings. Keep your book and a drink close by.
settings.tip_two: Give the chair a little space
settings.body_two: Allow room to sit down, stretch your legs and move around the chair. Check the dimensions before choosing your spot.
